title: Audit and repair POD5 signal decoder worker queue and synchronization
description: The signal decoder uses raw-pointer Send wrappers and a custom queue. Audit ownership and synchronization, including Queue::next remove/index behavior, push/fit ring-buffer invariants, and worker shutdown. Add concurrency and edge-case regression tests before treating signal decoding as production ready.

title: Implement and test POD5 public table read APIs
description: Implement read, signal and run-info table iteration and indexed record access, remove related todo and unimplemented code, and add real POD5 fixture coverage.
notes: Added out-of-bounds batch guards; iterator and record APIs still require concrete iterator types, record constructors, and behavior tests. Validate empty-batch behavior with real POD5 fixtures.

title: Implement POD5 signal codec and reconcile feature flags
description: Replace vendor codec stubs with tested POD5-compatible encode/decode and correct or remove unreachable SIMD feature configuration. Validate against real data and reference fixtures.
notes: Implemented scalar VBZ codec and connected sample count to decoder. Reference vector generated with pod5 0.3.36 validates decoding. Native zstd encoder records frame content size for reference-reader compatibility. Remaining: end-to-end real POD5 reads, additional encoder interoperability tests, handling trailing zstd frames, and SIMD routing. Signal worker safety tracked in somen-njr.

title: Restore POD5 workspace quality gates and CI coverage
description: Restore formatting and all-features lint/test checks after backend fixes; test fresh toolchain setup and expand feature coverage.
notes: cargo clippy --workspace --all-features -- --deny warnings fails on existing POD5 warnings, including unused imports, unexpected feature names, naming and lifetime diagnostics. cargo fmt --all -- --check also reports existing formatting drift. CI now provisions pinned flatc.

title: Harden POD5 IPC parsing against malformed block metadata
description: Validate signed offsets and lengths, overflow, buffer ranges, and message types and return errors for malformed files rather than panicking. Add targeted regression tests.
notes: IPC bounds and message framing are checked with regression tests. Lookup now supports empty batches. Remaining: validate with real POD5 fixtures and audit nested Arrow decoding and range consumers.

title: Provision Jbox Dockerfile with Rust and matching FlatBuffers compiler
description: The Debian 12 Jbox base lacks cargo/rustc, C build tools, jq/ripgrep, and flatc. Debian apt flatbuffers-compiler is 2.0.8 but the POD5 crate uses FlatBuffers 25.12.19. Add minimal development tools and pinned compatible flatc/Rust toolchain to .jbox/Dockerfile, validate in a disposable image, and avoid committing personal .jbox.toml settings.
close_reason: Built Jbox image on Debian 12 and verified Rust 1.98.1, flatc 25.12.19, development tools, non-root use, and cargo check --workspace inside disposable container

title: Rename POD5 crate directory to somen-pod5
description: Move only noodles-pod5/ to somen-pod5/, update workspace member path and live follow-up references, preserve all other parser directories. Verify cargo metadata, workspace check, and POD5 tests.
close_reason: Moved only the POD5 crate directory, updated workspace and live follow-up path, and verified Cargo metadata, full check, and 3 POD5 tests

title: Rename umbrella and POD5 packages to somen
description: Rename only the top-level noodles package to somen and noodles-pod5 package to somen-pod5, update their project-facing metadata/docs, and leave all other parser package names and sections untouched. Preserve existing uncommitted umbrella edits. Validate Cargo package IDs and workspace build/tests.
close_reason: Renamed umbrella to somen and POD5 to somen-pod5; metadata confirms all other parser package names unchanged; workspace check, umbrella BAM feature, and 3 POD5 tests pass

title: Finish POD5 public read APIs and feature-gated vendor codec
description: POD5 compiles but public operations still panic: io/vendor.rs decode/encode contain todo!, file/table/{read,signal,run_info}.rs iter/record contain todo!, record/batch/columns/arrays/large_dataset.rs index2 is unimplemented. vendor.rs checks svb-* features but Cargo.toml declares simd-* instead, leaving the alternate branch inaccessible. Add behavior-focused tests and resolve feature names before claiming usable POD5 I/O.
notes: Backend feature compilation repaired and cargo check -p somen-pod5 --all-features passed. Remaining codec and public table implementation are tracked in somen-cqe and somen-wj6.

title: Fix POD5 VBZ codec round-trip and buffer handling
description: cargo test -p noodles-pod5 --lib fails encode_decode_delta_boundaries with DataTruncated. Decoder indexes the combined control+data buffer rather than data_bytes; encoder sets the two-byte control bit for one-byte values; test pre-fills the output Vec although decoder appends. Fix and add boundary/truncation checks.
close_reason: Fixed and verified with cargo test -p noodles-pod5, cargo clippy -p noodles-pod5 --lib, and cargo check

title: Investigate POD5 signal codec compatibility
description: Implement verified POD5-compatible signal codec within vendor ownership, or document blockers.
notes: Reference vector generated using pod5 0.3.36 vbz_compress_signal. Decoder passes it; encoder emits a Zstandard frame with content size. Expand bidirectional interoperability coverage and real POD5 fixtures; current test is not end-to-end.

title: Support empty record batches in POD5 batch lookup
description: BatchIndexLookup currently stores inclusive bounds using total - 1 and binary_search, which underflows for an initial empty batch and can select an empty later batch. Support zero-length batches with correct lower-bound lookup, overflow handling, and tests. IPC parsing currently rejects empty batches as a safety guard.
close_reason: Batch lookup uses exclusive cumulative bounds and checked construction; empty batches, overflow and backward cache lookups have regression coverage. IPC accepts empty batches again; table-level fixture validation remains under somen-wj6.

title: Correct POD5 capacity tracker Clippy error and lock display
description: Clippy fails on u64 count <= 0 in Capacity::is_exhausted (absurd_extreme_comparisons denied). Capacity Display also prints is_loaded for IS_LOCKED. Replace comparison with == 0 and report actual lock state, then verify Clippy no hard errors.
close_reason: Fixed and verified with cargo test -p noodles-pod5, cargo clippy -p noodles-pod5 --lib, and cargo check

title: Document or eliminate somen-pod5 flatc build prerequisite
description: Workspace cargo check requires flatc because somen-pod5/build.rs invokes it. Decide whether to supply generated bindings or a managed compiler, or document a compatible flatc version and installation steps; verify a fresh workspace check.
notes: Jbox now supplies SHA256-verified flatc 25.12.19 in .jbox/Dockerfile, and an in-container workspace check passed. Non-Jbox fresh environments still need their own compatible flatc or documented installation, so this issue remains open.
close_reason: Documented flatc 25.12.19 and provisioned the checksum-verified compiler in CI; verified download and clean-target cargo check --workspace.
